dedupe_keys.name: fire stations city of san jose open data

description: A point layer of fire station locations in San Jose, California, published by the city's Enterprise GIS on its open data portal. The layer held 35 stations when read, each with a facility identifier, station number, street address parts, coordinates, status, battalion, apparatus, notes, a hose tower flag, links to a web page and photo, and creation and last update dates. Coverage: the City of San Jose only. Format and access: free download as CSV, Shapefile, GeoJSON or KML, or through the ArcGIS GeoServices REST service; the portal lists a Creative Commons Attribution licence and says data are published weekly on Mondays. Caveats: the layer describes stations, not response times, staffing or call records, and the licence version is not stated. Useful for emergency response and service coverage simulation, accessibility analysis and hazard exposure of critical facilities; related records are not yet linked.
